test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 10 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.

Wise managers _________ opinions, get information, ask advice, act ________ and know the art of __________ responsibilities to the subordinates.
solution:
The correct answer is, '**solicit, transparently, delegating**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Solicit** means **to request or ask**.

 
 
• Example - ***The school is soliciting the parents to be a part of this funding for orphans***.
 
 
 
• **Transparently** means **clear or truthful**
 
 
• Example - ***All his work and success is transparent***.
 
 
 
• **Delegating** means **assigning work or dividing work**.
 
 
• Example - ***The boss delegates his work proficiently***.
 
 
 
• The complete passage would be - **Wise managers solicit opinions, get information, ask advice, act transparently, and know the art of delegating responsibilities to the subordinates. **
